requirements.text: Every user account must have a globally unique email address in the system.
requirements.source_sentence: Every user account must have a globally unique email address in the system.

requirements.text: Email addresses must be validated using standard RFC 5322 format rules.
requirements.source_sentence: Email addresses must be validated using standard RFC 5322 format rules.

requirements.text: Family members can share a single email address across multiple accounts.
requirements.source_sentence: Family members can share a single email address across multiple accounts.

requirements.text: Users must verify their email address within 48 hours of registration.
requirements.source_sentence: Users must verify their email address within 48 hours of registration.

requirements.text: A user can change their email address up to 3 times per calendar year.
requirements.source_sentence: A user can change their email address up to 3 times per calendar year.

requirements.text: The system must send password reset links to the user's registered email.
requirements.source_sentence: The system must send password reset links to the user's registered email.

requirements.text: Accounts inactive for more than 12 months must be automatically deactivated.
requirements.source_sentence: Accounts inactive for more than 12 months must be automatically deactivated.

requirements.text: Administrators can manually assign or reassign email addresses to any account.
requirements.source_sentence: Administrators can manually assign or reassign email addresses to any account.

requirements.text: The system must log all email change events with timestamp and IP address.
requirements.source_sentence: The system must log all email change events with timestamp and IP address.

requirements.text: Users can set a secondary email address for notifications as needed.
requirements.source_sentence: Users can set a secondary email address for notifications as needed.

requirements.text: Email addresses must not be reused for 6 months after account deletion.
requirements.source_sentence: Email addresses must not be reused for 6 months after account deletion.

requirements.text: The system should send users weekly digest emails if they opt in.
